patches.message: Yes to the earlier "do the pipeline in Polars" suggestion — adopt it for the report as permission, not obligation: report dependencies become "standard library plus Polars", so the report may use Polars but does not have to. Ingest's requests permission and the global standard-library-only policy are unaffected. And reinstate the global error rule exactly as before: "raise ETLError with context; never bare except".
patches.rationale: Disambiguates the adopted quoted suggestion as a permission while preserving both gold labels. Report dependencies="standard library plus Polars" is a permission: the report may use Polars but is not obligated to, and the extent of adoption is stated explicitly as report-scoped only, keeping the turn a positive adoption of the previously quoted suggestion. Two pre-existing rules are declared unaffected rather than newly granted: ingest's requests permission and the global standard-library-only policy. The sole obligation is the verbatim reinstatement of global error_handling="raise ETLError with context; never bare except".

patches.message: Settling the emit question: failures inside emit must throw EmitError instead of returning a Result — that is a requirement for emit, not just permission. Outside emit, returning Result remains required exactly as before. Keep the language as TypeScript and keep the error name EmitError.
patches.rationale: Disambiguates the gold label as a requirement rather than the permission the earlier phrasing implied. Emit error_handling="throw EmitError" obligates failures inside emit to throw EmitError instead of returning Result, and the message states this requirement is scoped to emit only. The pre-existing obligation to return Result outside emit is reaffirmed, not altered, and the TypeScript language rule and EmitError naming rule are preserved. No new permissions are granted and no obligations beyond the emit-scoped throw requirement are introduced.
